positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Tech lead for a connected car integration project; Developed features, maintained Pandora’s Android and iOS codebase for automotive projects (Android Auto, Apple CarPlay, custom integrations with Pandora's app-layer protocol over Bluetooth and USB)
● Tech lead for Android integration with major audio consumer electronic partner (Websockets + P2P discovery)
● Developed features for Pandora on Android Wear 2.0 (standalone app for smart watches)
● Implemented features for Pandora Premium on Android
● Prototyped voice interaction for Android (won three internal hack-a-thon awards)
● Refactored Android casting codebase using dependency injection and design patterns to enable scaling and testing
● Refactored diverging codebases to share code using modules and gradle build flavors
● Setup build variants (Gradle), obfuscation (Proguard), and continuous integration (Jenkins) for Android Wear 2.0, FireTV, and Google TV
● Wrote unit tests for features and bug fixes in Android (JUnit, Mockito, EasyMock) and iOS (Kiwi, OCMock, XCTest)
● Cross-team communication, performed technical presentations, and produced technical documentation

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Lead, executed, and released to app store multiple successful Android projects from requirements to completion for clients ranging from medium to large-scale corporations
● Developed Android applications and libraries using RESTful APIs, XML, JSON, Proguard, SSL, Retrofit and native HTTP, push notifications (via GCM), payment integration, native maps with geographical data
● Used Object-Orientation and Design Patterns in Agile and Waterfall app development life cycles
● Developed features in a SOAP-to-REST proxy (Java/Spring/Guava)

positions.title: Post-doctoral researcher and developer
positions.description: ● Developed software (Python, Verilog, Encounter RTL, FreePDK) to create x86 decoders, analyze critical-path performance, power, and area based on instruction support policies

positions.title: Post-doctoral researcher and developer
positions.description:
● Set up a cloud infrastructure (OpenNebula+Xen) for virtual nodes running Hadoop with Mahout 
● Instructor for Algorithms and Data Structures II course using the C language (200+ students)

volunteerExperiences.description:
● Journals: IEEE TPDS 2009, ACM TECS 2013, Elsevier Sustainable Computing 2014, Elsevier Cluster Computing 2014, Springer Cluster 2015, Springer JCST 2015, Elsevier Design Automation for Embedded Systems 2016
● Conferences: ACM ISCA 2012, IEEE ISCAS 2013
● Workshops: WSO 2008
